observations:
Torah #148 contains a single thematic cluster (Package 1: יִרְאָה וְאֵין סוֹף) with three concept-nodes: יִרְאָה, עֲנָוָה, and חָכְמָה, plus the structural descriptor אֵין סוֹף. The Torah is three lines long and constitutes a single unified philosophical aphorism about the infinite recursive depth of fear of God.

No new cross-Torah package domain emerges from this Torah for two reasons:

1. INSUFFICIENT SIZE: The entire Torah yields only 3 bechina edges and 4 nodes. The threshold for proposing a new package domain (3+ bechina-connected concepts forming an independent domain not already represented in the dataset) is met minimally, but the domain — infinite recursive יִרְאָה — is already a well-established cluster in the broader dataset. יִרְאָה, חָכְמָה, and עֲנָוָה are all hub-nodes that appear across dozens of other Torahs. Torah #148 adds no structurally novel bechina cluster that is independent of these existing domains.

2. NO INDEPENDENT DOMAIN: The three concepts (יִרְאָה, עֲנָוָה, חָכְמָה) are all standard nodes in the larger dataset and their bechina relationships are already implied by many other Torahs. The distinctive contribution of Torah #148 is not a new conceptual domain but a new STRUCTURAL PROPERTY of יִרְאָה: its infinite self-referential recursion (יִרְאָה contains יִרְאָה to אֵין סוֹף). This structural insight is captured by the יִרְאָה ↔ אֵין סוֹף edge, which adds a new traversal connection between the יִרְאָה hub and the אֵין סוֹף node — but this does not constitute a new independent package.

The Torah's argument in one move:
  [Pkg 1: good] יִרְאָה / עֲנָוָה / חָכְמָה → structural proof: fear appears as both heel-of-humility AND crown-of-wisdom → therefore fear transcends fixed hierarchical position → it ascends to אֵין סוֹף

No evil mirror, no secondary domain, no new package type warranted. Torah #148 is a minimal, concentrated Torah whose entire content fits within the single יִרְאָה package.
